title: DR1's submitted page tells the user what is still outstanding before the consignment is imported; the frontend's confirmation page says nothing about it.

finding.frontend: After submitting, the page runs from the green confirmation panel straight to a date of declaration and then "Transporting the consignment" (`src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/confirmation/template.njk:11-13`). Nothing on the page, and no key in its copy file, tells the user that anything is still owed. A notification can reach this page with no documents uploaded at all — the documents obligation allows nought to ten with no minimum (`src/server/app/sets/live-animals/obligations/sections/documents.js:19-28`) — so a user can submit without the health certificate and be told nothing.
finding.prototype: DR1 shows a "Before the consignment is imported" section immediately under the panel, introduced by "You still need to:" and listing what is outstanding for this particular notification. The two lines it can show are "upload the health certificate and any other required documents", when nothing has been uploaded, and "complete the animal identifier information in the notification", when identifiers are required and the minimum for submitting has been met but not all of them are filled in (`app/views/notification-submitted.html:27-37`). The section is not rendered when the list is empty, so a complete notification sees the page the frontend shows today.
finding.difference: Add the section to the confirmation page, built from the notification's own state at the moment of submission, and suppress it when the list comes back empty. The first line needs only a check of whether any document was saved, which the frontend already holds. The second line needs the frontend to decide what "the minimum for submitting" means for animal identifiers — its own gate onto this page is a roll-up of task-row statuses rather than a per-animal count — so if that question is not yet settled, ship the documents line first and add the identifier line when it is. No backend change is involved either way: both facts are already in the saved notification.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding that the frontend refuses to submit a notification with no documents uploaded, which would leave DR1's first outstanding-task line with nothing to report.
finding.verification: Read both DOMs, opened both full-page shots, read confirmation/template.njk:4-13, obligations/sections/documents.js:19-28 and notification-submitted.html:27-37, and followed the prototype's own logic rather than trusting the view — `getConditionalSubmissionItems` at app/routes.js:5674-5692 pushes exactly the two strings the finding quotes, under exactly the two conditions it states, and `renderNotificationSubmittedPage` sets `isIncompleteSubmission` from `beforeImportItems.length > 0`, so the suppress-when-empty claim is literal. Ran the falsifier two ways rather than reading the obligation alone, because a no-minimum group is a claim about markup until the journey agrees with it: `minEntries` appears exactly once in the whole live-animals obligation set, on commodities/lines.js:29, never on documents; and the frontend's own task list settles it in one word — fe-hub.html renders the Uploaded documents row with the status "Optional". It does not fire. CORRECT.

relatedTo.why: That finding makes the documents row a real task rather than Optional and then says the outstanding upload must be shown to the user afterwards, which is this finding's whole content. Unlinked until the duplicate sweep; this one owns the confirmation-page section.
